scope: Reconstructed Apollo radio GPIO consumer, GPIO117 control/setup, verifier, provenance, tests and cumulative accounting
verified_contracts: Callback increments modulo-2^32 counter before submitting handler ID byte and event 1 to the WsfSetEvent boundary.
ISR keeps seven raw channel0 snapshot reads ordered, restores PRIMASK, then reads raw IRQ59 status, clears, and services the same mask.
GPIO enable and disable preserve other EN bits under real PRIMASK; setup writes IPR byte 0x40 then ISER1 bit27.
Original OTA and all pinned consumer/control/wrapper/tail ranges are hash-authenticated.
Cumulative inventory hashes and callable ELF hashes match current files.
material_limits: WsfSetEvent internals, event-loop effects, scheduler initialization and actual delivery are intercepted/unproven.
No physical pad/NVIC behavior, asynchronous IRQ timing, callback concurrency, reentrancy, publication atomicity, teardown quiescence, or counter race safety is proven.
Disable clears only GPIO EN bit21; it does not clear pending status, unregister callback, disable NVIC or drain queued events.
Implementation covers the authenticated radio setup tail and pin-specific operations, not complete boot/teardown or a production firmware bundle.
nonblocking_test_scope_note: Build integration unit test does not separately enumerate enable/disable/setup symbols; the 180-case verifier resolves and exercises these functions.
